title: Beach Games
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Beach Games', the office staff participate in various beach activities and contests, including a hot dog eating contest won by Andy Bernard, a coal walk challenge, and sumo suit competition. Michael considers his potential successor and discusses the importance of image and qualities like courage. The episode features humorous interactions, conflicts over team names, and reflections on leadership and personal relationships.

main_threads.thread: Office staff participate in beach activities and contests, with Michael evaluating potential successors.
